task: Define all III.B mathematical roles and derive the torque-dependent next-step energy predictor

mathematical_roles.H: State-only energy map retained from III.A; its three component functions are named at first use.
mathematical_roles.f: Four physical-state rates from the governing dynamics.
mathematical_roles.F_s: Physical-state predictor defined by the integral initial-value relation; s is elapsed time and sigma is its integration variable.
mathematical_roles.DH: 3-by-4 Jacobian of the energy map with respect to the physical state.
mathematical_roles.DH*f: Instantaneous vector of arm kinetic, pendulum kinetic, and potential energy rates.
mathematical_roles.H_Delta: Torque-dependent next-step energy predictor, H composed with F_Delta; the integrated Jacobian identity derives its energy change.
mathematical_roles.W_Delta: Signed motor work, obtained by integrating total energy rate; constant torque times predicted arm displacement.
mathematical_roles.E: Total energy, the sum of the energy-map components.
mathematical_roles.physical_energy_set: Image of physical states under H, explicitly linked on first appearance to the later inequalities and constructive realization.
mathematical_roles.requested_energy_set: Physical portion of the plane fixing next-step total energy.
mathematical_roles.torque_curve: Image of the bounded scalar torque interval under H_Delta at fixed current state and duration.
mathematical_roles.F_hat_and_W_hat: RK4 state prediction and torque-displacement work used by the implementation.
mathematical_roles.candidate_set: Finite torque grid and bracket-refined trials with finite predictions.
mathematical_roles.sample_times: Finite integration sample times including the current and next update.
mathematical_roles.V_hat_plus_and_Theta_hat: Explicit equations for next-step potential energy and maximum sampled absolute arm angle.
mathematical_roles.score_and_argmin: Dimensionless weighted penalties and selection of a minimum-score candidate.

implementation_checks: The implementation integrates the physical dynamics and then applies the state-only energy map.
Jacobian evaluation is used in the mathematical derivation; no unimplemented online Jacobian evaluation or inverse operation is asserted.
Work depends on torque as an explicit multiplier and through coupled accelerations and predicted arm displacement.
Curve membership in the physical-energy set is justified by the composition H(F_Delta).
Curve-plane intersections are equivalent to the exact scalar work equation in the lossless model.
Numerical integration error and incomplete finite root sampling remain explicit.
All tested candidates share the existing score; the arm restriction remains a soft sampled penalty.
